name: temporal-capture-tagging
description: Auto-tag captures with temporal state (past/present/future) to improve retrieval relevance and enable time-aware queries
steps: Define temporal states: past (complete, archived, learned), present (active, building, current), future (plan, upcoming, awaiting)
Create keyword detection rules for auto-classification
Tag each capture with temporal_state and confidence
Store temporal classification in capture metadata
Enable temporal-aware queries: prioritize 'present' for active work, 'past' for history
Use as secondary sort key after relevance score
triggers: user asks 'what am I building?' (prioritize present)
user asks 'what did I complete?' (filter to past)
examples: 'Complete the auth module' → temporal: past, confidence: 0.9
'Building a new trading bot' → temporal: present, confidence: 0.85
'Plan to refactor next week' → temporal: future, confidence: 0.8
Query 'active projects' → filter temporal=present, sort by confidence
